name: Building Complaint Disposition Codes
description:
This dataset is a reference table that maps short disposition codes to their full descriptions for building complaints. It contains 160 rows and two columns: a code (such as A2, A6, or EA) and the corresponding disposition text, which describes the outcome or status of a complaint, such as a summons being served, a violation being issued, or a complaint being assigned to a specific unit. Each code appears to correspond to a single disposition, with nearly all values unique.

The table is useful as a lookup or decoding resource. Anyone working with building complaint records that use these codes can join this table to translate codes into readable descriptions, making reports and analyses easier to interpret. It could also support filtering or grouping complaints by outcome type, auditing how dispositions are labeled, or building dashboards and data pipelines that require human-readable status labels.
